theorems.name: Submission.deGiorgiRH_measure_le_two_pow_mul_hausdorff
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Rn N)) (A : Set (Rn N)), (∀ x ∈ A, Tendsto (fun ρ : ℝ ↦ μ (Metric.closedBall x ρ) / ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ n)) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 (volume (Metric.ball (0 : Rn n) 1)))) → μ A ≤ 2 ^ n * μHE[n] A
